📱 Your reel did one job. Who does the other three?

A reel is good at one thing: being seen by people who don’t know you yet. But patients rarely book straight from a reel. Between watching and calling, three more jobs have to happen, and each one lives somewhere else.

1️⃣ Be seen: reels and posts put your face and your way of explaining in front of new people.
2️⃣ Be believed: your website explains treatments, doctors and timings in plain words.
3️⃣ Be found: your Google Business Profile shows the right hours, services and location when someone searches.
4️⃣ Be easy to reach: call and WhatsApp, one tap away on every page and profile.

✅ If one job is weak, the others can’t make up for it. Fix the weakest first, not the loudest.

🔖 Save this and test one job each week this month.
